title: Maneater
prepared_input_summary: Open-world RPG power fantasy where the player is a giant shark.
relevant_profile_signals: Movement itself can be a major source of enjoyment when it feels expressive and satisfying.
Clear progression with visible effects is a strong positive.
Open worlds are positive when they provide dense reasons to explore rather than empty repetition.
Distinctive identity and humor/atmosphere raise fit.

retrieval_actions.query_or_request: "Maneater" official gameplay evolve shark abilities open world RPG
retrieval_actions.source_page_identity: PlayStation Blog developer feature for Maneater
retrieval_actions.factual_evidence_obtained: Developers describe fast, fluid traversal, varied visceral attacks, leveling from a shark pup into a much larger predator, evolutions that change combat, eight distinct regions with different ecosystems, and a humorous narrated revenge story.

decision_basis: The exact-product source aligns with several of the profile's strongest signals simultaneously: satisfying movement, obvious power growth, combat-changing upgrades, varied exploration regions and a distinctive humorous identity.
continuation_reason: Fast-level evidence is strong and no permitted stop condition is observable.
